negative_reviews.author: Kayden Fahey
negative_reviews.text: The vegan tantan had little to no taste, just watery broth and a handful of toppings. The vegan bacon was overcooked and like rubber. Added fried tofu for £3.50 which had no seasoning, just a block of plain tofu fried for a few seconds. My fiancé liked his meat dish, and my friend said the same about her seafood hell ramen. Vegan option just lacking in flavour
